currentParagraphText: “Do hang on, everyone. The process is still a bit crude, and getting pulled through the void doesn’t tend to be the most pleasant of experiences. Especially for any first-timers,” Jake warned them all as he felt the bridge between universes form.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Do hang on, everyone. The process is still a bit crude, and getting pulled through the void doesn’t tend to be the most pleasant of experiences. Especially for any first-timers,” Jake warned them all as he felt the bridge between universes form.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake was ready as he braced himself for the journey through the void. He half-expected something to happen, but the seconds passed as he felt completely and utterly disorientated. Then, without further warning, he felt solid ground beneath his feet as his vision returned.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Oh, of course, let’s get going,” Jake said apologetically before he motioned for everyone to follow him as they headed down to this lab. Once there, they went to the room with the teleportation circle already prepared, and using his connection with the Malefic Viper as his Chosen, Jake began the minor ritual to initiate the teleportation.
